    ctx := authContext{teleportCluster: teleportClusterClient{name: \"site a\"}, Context: auth.Context{User: user}}

    got := f.getClusterSession(ctx)

    c.Assert(got.authContext.teleportCluster.name, check.Equals, \"\")
}
''' + s[end:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
go test ./lib/kube/proxy -run 'Test/TestGetClusterSession' -count=1"
